scene.observation_budget: entire supplied recording observed-static union; same observer/world/split only; dynamics current frame
scene.coordinate_protocol: persistent world map; transform to current window anchor at query
scene.evaluation_input_scope: supplied recording only; restricted benchmark clips must use a restricted observation manifest

feedback.position_protocol: root translation and SO3 FK, fixed bone lengths

config.training_status: Frozen full-pool fresh ego;55k LR horizon; stop and review at1000; no automatic EXO.

validation.scope: Ego phase only:3 fixed+3 rotating official VAL windows, clean/noisy separate; first update3 fixed only; scene-OFF at5000; full final evaluation protocol unchanged.

config.exo_window_policy: at least one observed joint; maximum 18 consecutive all-joint-missing raw30 frames; partial joint occlusion retained; full static recording memory unchanged

reference_input.coordinate_frame: same fixed window world coordinates as scene and observed tracks
reference_input.fallback: observed-track kinematic initializer with supplied rest bones; no GT motion
reference_input.occluded_prior: retain full estimated motion; encode low position/rotation confidence
reference_input.availability: real video frontend predictions are not yet in current dataset cache

refinement.placement: predicted proposal and final x0 within diffusion
refinement.exo: confidence/uncertainty weighted observed torso rigid pose
refinement.ego: head position translation only; no camera-to-body heading constraint
refinement.joint_anchor_schedule: cosine alpha; skip alpha<0.05; predicted proposal and final x0; root excluded

scene_relations.input_policy: predicted body and trusted tracks only; broad upward samples are context, not completed surfaces

physical_guidance.acceptance: joint physical/observation/prior energy decreases and trusted measurements protected
physical_guidance.placement: every clean x0 before next DDIM update; shallow observed support only

sampler.dataset_weights: preserve per-mode sqrt(valid-window-count) corpus weights and EgoBody role weights
sampler.recording_weights: equal recording cycles per group/mode, no replacement until cycle ends
sampler.windows: without replacement per recording/mode; prefer no overlap with recent same-target windows across modes; logged fallback if exhausted

runtime.protocol: canonical geometry and GT supervision then shared rigid yaw; same protocol as prior pilot
runtime.cache_location: E drive adjacent to raw30 cache
runtime.unchanged: B2 FP32 L192 S64 DDIM20 scales/neighbors physics/IK iteration counts and loss coefficients

phase_plan.next_phase: exo adaptation with ego retention, followed by low-LR joint training, contingent on validation
phase_plan.mixed_control: same seed/initial weights, input protocol, optimizer schedule and matched per-mode sample budgets; not yet run
phase_plan.budget_status: Global cap55000 from scratch; first review1000; later continuation requires validation review.

selection: First legal window per recording in the sealed identity-only cohort; all eligible RICH, first8 TRUMANS/EgoBody; never ranked by errors.
panels: Only the first4 recordings/dataset (12 dev) are used at interim stage checks; remaining31 confirmation reserved for final stage.

arms.none: use_scene=False; all learned scene paths and physical guidance off; observation/IK anchors retained
arms.learned_only: use_scene=True; all learned scene conditioning and feedback retained; physical guidance off
arms.full: use_scene=True; original learned scene paths and original physical guidance on

reference_policy: original sealed observation-derived EGO reference; no EXO policy or yaw override
diagnostic_scope: Per-DDIM-step compact coverage, feedback, contact and physical diagnostics; no new GT inference inputs.
candidate_registration: Completed candidates use a separate immutable --out with the same source cohort/config and explicit --models JSON.
reuse_policy: No old prediction reuse: stages require original sampler diagnostics for every arm.
seed_aggregation: Final seed0 and seed1 use separate immutable outputs; average both, never best-of-two.

input_models_registry.role: Provenance only; mutable input registry is not a sealed dependency.

checkpoint_pinning: os.link pins the published inode; only pinned registry/checkpoints are active dependencies. Training may atomically replace last.pt.
